title: Listing history
lead: Find a listing's recorded changes, who made them and the publication evidence.
referenceHint: Enter the exact listing reference shown in Inventory.
checkOnly: This check only reads the recorded result. It does not repeat the change or publish anything.
unknownActor: No matching staff directory name is available for the recorded actor.
privateActor: The recorded actor is not a staff directory identity.
noReason: No reason was stored with this event.
retainUnknown: Recorded decision: retain the unknown price for the source revision.
redaction: Contact details and credentials in free text are hidden.
noFields: This event has no additional supported change fields.
noOldValues: Old field values were not stored in this event. Today's listing is not substituted for its historical content.
empty: No recorded listing changes to show
emptyHelp: No events match this reference within your current listing and history access. Older history is not reconstructed.
invalid: These history filters could not be used
invalidHelp: Use one exact listing reference and open older changes from the history list.
failedHelp: Check this page again. Reading history does not repeat a business action.
working: Recorded working change. This event did not publish a listing.
prepared: A publication package was prepared. Preparation is not publication.
published: Website publication was recorded and verified for this exact package.
unconfirmed: This record alone does not confirm publication.
other: A listing event was recorded. No publication result is inferred from it.
boundary: This history is not a customer receipt and does not confirm delivery to every external destination.

current.active: This package is currently active on the website.
current.replaced: This package is no longer the current publication.
current.none: No current publication pointer is recorded.
